title: Move proof image followups
goal: Update PR #936 with the proof-only move image speedup, keep Pi goal artifacts uncommitted by policy, make the move-envelope speed benchmark reusable with optional proof-image mode, broaden targeted proof-image validation by one package-heavy row, document manual/nightly all-proofs usage with proof image, and identify safe next product-proof wave candidates without broad restore or daemon claims.

proofChecklist.obligation: Prove PR #936 was updated to include the proof-only move image speedup work, the php-static timing comparison of default 127.433s versus proof-image 29.156s, the provisioning drop from 107623ms to 162ms, and the proof-only/non-runtime boundary.
proofChecklist.evidence: Updated PR #936 with /tmp/pr-936-proof-image-update.md via `gh pr edit 936 --body-file /tmp/pr-936-proof-image-update.md`. Verification `gh pr view 936 --json url,title,body` confirmed https://github.com/redwoodjs/machinen/pull/936 still has title `Graduate generic move resource graph wave 3` and its body contains the required speed evidence strings `127.433s`, `29.156s`, `107623ms`, and `162ms`, plus proof-only/non-runtime boundary text including `not a product base asset` and `not selected by runtime defaults`. The PR body also states the proof image is not copied into packages/native-* release assets and runtime users do not need it.

proofChecklist.obligation: Prove the .pi/goals controller evidence policy was decided and applied: .pi/* goal artifacts remain uncommitted unless explicitly intended, and the working tree status confirms they are not staged for commit.
proofChecklist.evidence: Decision: keep .pi goal artifacts as local controller evidence and do not stage/commit them unless explicitly requested. Verification `git status --short .pi .pi/goals/move-proof-image-followups.json` shows .pi/extensions/ and .pi/goals/*.json, including .pi/goals/move-proof-image-followups.json and .pi/goals/move-proof-image-validation-speedup.json, are untracked (`??`) and not staged. No .pi files were added to the commit set.

proofChecklist.obligation: Prove scripts/move-envelope-speed-benchmark.mjs can optionally pass a proof image to matrix chunks through a flag or environment variable without breaking existing fresh, warm, or parallel modes.
proofChecklist.evidence: Updated scripts/move-envelope-speed-benchmark.mjs to accept `--image <path>` with default from MACHINEN_MOVE_MATRIX_IMAGE, resolve and validate that the image exists, include proofImage metadata in benchmark-summary.json, pass `--image <path>` through every matrix chunk in fresh/parallel modes, and boot warm-mode reused VMs with the positional proof image before running chunks with `--reuse-vms`. Existing fresh/warm/parallel mode selection remains unchanged; only optional image args are appended. Validation `node --check scripts/move-envelope-speed-benchmark.mjs` passed in 0.021s, and fresh proof-image benchmark execution passed against scripts/smoke/move-envelope-speed-plan.json with proofImage metadata in /tmp/move-speed-proof-image-followup2/benchmark-summary.json.

proofChecklist.obligation: Prove reusable speed benchmark evidence compares the existing chunk plan with and without proof-image mode, records timing output, and verifies chunk-plan coverage without rerunning the full all-proofs matrix.
proofChecklist.evidence: Ran the reusable speed benchmark against scripts/smoke/move-envelope-speed-plan.json without the full all-proofs matrix. Default fresh run: `node scripts/move-envelope-speed-benchmark.mjs --mode fresh --plan scripts/smoke/move-envelope-speed-plan.json --out-dir /tmp/move-speed-default-followup --label default-followup --json` passed in 125.538s wall clock, summary totalWallMs=125503, coverage state=passed. Proof-image fresh run after timing-label fix: `node scripts/move-envelope-speed-benchmark.mjs --mode fresh --plan scripts/smoke/move-envelope-speed-plan.json --out-dir /tmp/move-speed-proof-image-followup2 --label proof-image-followup2 --image /tmp/machinen-move-proof-image-cache/move-proof-image-arm64-c7c0c1d96a7a.tar.gz --json` passed in 116.735s wall clock, summary totalWallMs=116707, proofImage metadata recorded, and chunk timings included proof-image:move-proof-image-arm64-c7c0c1d96a7a.tar.gz:chunk-plan-skip details. proofChecklist.obligation: Prove proof-image validation was broadened with one additional package-heavy targeted row such as nginx-static, redis-idle, or socat-file-responder, including retained artifact and timing evidence, while still not running the full matrix.

JSON evidence shows loaderStrategy=target-native-nginx-static-loader, targetResponseContains=`nginx proof 15F`, targetPid=472, boot-pair detail=fresh-vms:proof-image:move-proof-image-arm64-c7c0c1d96a7a.tar.gz, provision-pair durationMs=136, and proof:nginx-static durationMs=12103.

proofChecklist.obligation: Prove row-local ensure helper cleanup or standardization was assessed and only implemented if it reduced risk/duplication without changing runtime behavior; otherwise record why deferring it is safer.
proofChecklist.evidence: Assessed row-local ensure helper cleanup with `rg -n "^ensure_.*_tool\(\)|test -x /usr/bin|test -x /usr/sbin|command -v" scripts/smoke/move-envelope-matrix.sh`. The current helpers already use binary-first checks before apt fallback for Python, BusyBox, OpenBSD nc, rsync, PHP, Ruby, Caddy, nginx, Postgres, Redis, socat, zip/unzip, tree, zstd, and generic Python. The proof-image validator now centralizes the broad tool-presence check. A larger refactor into a shared shell ensure wrapper was deferred because it would touch many proven matrix rows and increase regression risk without changing runtime behavior; the safer low-risk path is to keep existing binary-first row helpers and rely on the proof-image validator plus targeted rows to avoid apt work when tools are present.

proofChecklist.obligation: Prove docs include a manual/nightly/release all-proofs matrix command using the proof image, while preserving normal PR validation as targeted rows plus coverage.
proofChecklist.evidence: Updated docs/snapshot/move-envelope-framework.md Matrix and remote validation policy. It now includes a concrete manual/nightly/release all-proofs command that builds/selects PROOF_IMAGE with `pnpm --silent move-envelope:build-proof-image -- --json` and runs `MACHINEN_MOVE_MATRIX_KEEP_WORK=1 pnpm proof-move-envelope-matrix -- --json --timings --image "$PROOF_IMAGE"`. The same section keeps normal PR validation as targeted rows plus coverage and documents reusable speed benchmark commands for default and proof-image chunk-plan comparisons.

proofChecklist.obligation: Prove the next product-proof wave candidates are documented as scoped follow-up options, with explicit non-claims for arbitrary process restore, broad daemon support, source-ISA emulation, and broad generic service migration.
proofChecklist.evidence: Added `Scoped next product-proof wave options` to docs/snapshot/move-envelope-framework.md. It lists scoped follow-up options: stronger service parity/refusal rows for one exact static or idle service shape at a time; descriptor-harness rows graduating to live-capture rows only when the same resource graph and refusal boundaries are observed; and additional fd/resource classes with exact preflight and no-launch refusal evidence. The section explicitly states these are not claims of arbitrary process restore, any-binary movement, broad daemon support, source-ISA emulation, interactive terminal migration, broad generic service migration, or metadata-only success.
